desc: Formalize the red and blue operation sequences as total orders based on distance to X in P-cycles and Q-cycles respectively.
Characterize the condition for a box i to be operated once to serve both its red and blue jobs (i.e., the operation time must be after both the red and blue predecessors have been operated).
Model the problem as merging two sequences with the ability to interleave operations and combine matching boxes when the order constraints allow.
Derive an efficient algorithm (O(N) or O(N log N)) to compute the minimum number of operations, considering intersections and order conflicts between R_seq and B_seq.
Verify the algorithm logic on the provided sample cases (Sample 1, 2, 3, 4) by mentally running the code and checking outputs.
Implement the solution in Python, ensuring it handles N up to 2e5 efficiently.
Write the final code to read input, compute the answer, and print the result to stdout.
